name: 自相关规律性分析
description: 检测 periodic auto相关性 peaks that suggest resampling or AI upsampling 伪影 in the image structure.
mechanism: Computes the normalized auto相关性 function over grayscale pixel rows and columns at multiple lags. Periodic peaks in the auto相关性 indicate resampling 伪影 from interpolation or AI upsampling, 其 produce predictable periodicity absent in natural images captured directly by camera sensors.
parameters: Max lag: 32 pixels, 块大小: 128x128. Sampling: row+column pairs, Normalization: zero-lag division
accuracy: Moderate — 65-78%, best combined with 频谱分析
source: Popescu & Farid (2005) — Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling, IEEE TSP
useCase: Detecting resampling and upsampling 伪影 characteristic of AI image generation pipelines

references.title: Popescu, A.C. & Farid, H. (2005). Exposing Digital Forgeries by Detecting Traces of Resampling. IEEE TSP.
Kirchner, M. (2008). Fast and Reliable Resampling Detection by Spectral Analysis of Fixed Linear Predictor Residue. ACM MM&Sec.

strengths:
• 检测 resampling 伪影 invisible to human eye
• Fast computation on local pixel blocks
• Mathematical foundation in signal processing
• Complementary to spectral Nyquist 分析
limitations:
• Sensitivity drops with heavy JPEG压缩
• Natural textures with periodic 模式 cause 误报
• Small images may not have enough data
• Some AI models avoid resampling entirely
